open.title: Gift guide with the price on the image

lessons.text: Naming the belt next to the offer beats the plain offer line.
Openers that start on the buckle clicking shut stop more people than a face to camera.
lessons.note: Hook rate 33% against a normal of 22%, across 3 videos.

lessons.text: Gift stills work for past buyers and lose money for new people.
Creator videos start journeys but rarely close them. Judge them on first click sales.
lessons.note: First click sales 2.6 times last click on the three creator videos.

lessons.text: Real people only. No made-up faces in our ads, ever.
Unboxing openers are the weakest way into a video for this brand.
lessons.note: Only 2 videos. Too early to say.

lessons.text: A ball marker in the buckle is a feature people click on, not one they buy on.
Fairway Supply runs every sale for two weeks with one hero still. Their longest ad is 94 days old.
Black belts sell better than brown in winter.
